statements: Current slice implements the shared CPU exact-path kernel, resumable job representation and an actual separate Web Worker/WASM executor. It does not activate asynchronous canonical commits yet. This is the first vertical slice of user-authorized CPU Worker migration, not the full promised immediate-next-edit behavior.

Existing Runtime/Interaction remains sole input/admission/state/OperationEngine/History owner. Render owns derived caches, qualified publication and GPU context. Worker owns only isolated CPU computation/job scratch. No Worker RuntimeComposition, SemanticDocument, OperationEngine, Scene owner or GPU surface.

All geometry, validation of geometry values, f32 conversion, stroke construction, sequential PathOps and path decode happen in shared C++ compiled to WASM. JS may perform bounded transport/envelope checks, transfer buffers, scheduling/cancel and lifecycle only, never implement a second geometry/hit/brush/mask algorithm.

Extract existing local erasePath Sweep/Filled implementation into one private Render CPU implementation consumed by main and Worker targets. Preserve original f32/persegment Round stroke/sequential leftfold union/order/filled-fillrule/failure/finiteness semantics. No worldunion-theninverse, balancing, approximation or AA/Brush changes.

Represent partial work with fully qualified immutable source and a cursor/computed-prefix path; partial never masquerades as complete. Native reference path remains independently frozen as oracle, not calling the extracted optimized implementation for expected results.

No background job can directly update existing non-atomic usage/caches or mutable replayOutput. Transfer an independent task-owned value/byte representation, no pointer/Skia context/SDK internals cross JS business exports.

Use accepted prebuilt singlethreaded Skia/Semantic supplies. A separate Worker may instantiate CPU-only WASM without pthread/sharedmemory. No dependency source rebuild/newlock/native std::thread pool/OffscreenCanvas/GPU owner move in CW1.

Sidecar is private normal-package infrastructure, linked from same build/package and bound to its kernel/protocol identity; root SDK business exports remain unchanged. CW1 may compile/package sidecar but must not silently activate asynchronous editing/public-contract behavior before CW2.

Later CW2 must model Up as input terminal plus pending semantic work; clear pointer contacts and preserve original confirmed coordinates, then owner validates and atomically commits in order. CW3 must cover immediate eraser/nav/shape/sticky/table/image/UndoRedo. These later product behaviors are authorized goals but are not to be implemented by guessing missing semantics in CW1.
Preserve all prior HP/TP/CFH/LQP evidence including LQP FROZEN_PROOF_INCOMPLETE and retained local raw files. CW1 does not retroactively close the missing Web Up roots.
